request.text: I want new wired USB-C earbuds with a microphone for phone calls. What is the delivered price to Saida?

message:
Best confirmed-new option: Mobileleb Apple EarPods (USB-C), $24.00, in stock, with a microphone and call controls. Delivery charges to Saida were not published in the checked sources, so I cannot confirm a delivered total.
Other in-stock options:
• Macrotronics JBL Tune 310C: $19.38, USB-C wired with a mic; new condition and delivery fee unconfirmed. Tax included.
• Classic Phones Samsung AKG USB-C, black: $12.00, wired with an inline microphone. Delivery across Lebanon is advertised, but the fee and new condition are unconfirmed.
I suggest the Mobileleb EarPods because their new condition is explicit; check compatibility with your phone and the Saida delivery charge before buying.

product.title: Jbl Tune 310c usb-c wired earphones
product.description:
JBL TUNE 310C USB-C Wired Hi-Res In-Ear Headphones
Description
Hi-Res Audio with JBL Pure Bass Sound. Now available to go.
Introducing JBL Tune 310C USB-C in-ear headphones. They’re lightweight,comfortable and compact. A pair of 9mm dynamic drivers punch out powerful JBL Pure Bass Sound, while the High-Resolution Audio support ensures great sound quality. A USB-C connection makes them compatible with a large variety of devices like PCs, mobiles, and gaming devices. In addition, the three-button remote on a tangle-free flat cable lets you control music playback and volume adjustment, EQ presets, as well as answering calls on the fly with a built-in microphone. All this makes the JBL Tune 310C USB-C your everyday companion, at work, at home, and on the road.
JBL Pure Bass sound, Hi-Res certified
For over 75 years, JBL has engineered the precise, impressive sound found in big venues around the world. These headphones reproduce that same JBL sound, punching out bass that’s deep, powerful. Hi-Res Audio brings clear and detailed sound quality with a wide frequency range
Compatible with USB-C devices
Need to connect to a PC, mobile or gaming device? USB-C connectivity ensures compatibility with a wide range of devices*. *Please check USB-C compatibility with your device.
3-button remote with microphone
Control music playback and volume adjustment with a convenient three-button remote. Got an incoming call? Answer it on the fly with the built-in microphone.
